scientific_integrity: An exact 49-support finite reduction supplies the unrestricted proof; independent brute-force finite-size simulations and randomized larger instances corroborate the support calculation. Established arbitrary-graph qualitative asymptotic results remain prior work; new priority is not independently certified. The motivating 1993 archival preprint has a verified posting date, whereas the original 1978 founding paper is identified only to publication month.
scientific_limitations: Threshold-one synchronous three-state dynamics only, on finite complete bipartite graphs with nonempty parts; no extension asserted to arbitrary finite graphs, higher thresholds or additional colors. Independent mathematical validation and a fully exhaustive historical-priority check remain unperformed.
title: A four-step relaxation law and complete orbit-depth census for bipartite excitable dynamics
